description: Filter dining hall menus by allergen, trait, nutrient density, carbon, calories, sodium and name. All params optional. Allergens/traits are slugs; read key for codes. min_mhealthy: keep tiers >= (1-5). max_carbon: keep tiers <= (1 low, 2 medium, 3 high). nutrients: range per nutrient. query: case-insensitive substring. Rows are coded arrays; read key. stale means expired cache; asOf data age. Allergens advisory.

date.description: A single day to filter. Cannot be combined with from/to.

exclude_allergens.description: Keeps only the dishes that carry none of these allergens.

from.description: The first day of a range to filter.

hall.description: Halls: one, a list, or none for all.

include_nutrients.description: Nutrients to return, by key/name, or ["all"].

max_carbon.description: The highest acceptable carbon footprint: 1 (low), 2 (medium) or 3 (high). The dishes the site did not tag are dropped.

min_mhealthy.description: The lowest acceptable nutrient-density tier. The dishes the site did not tag are dropped.

max.description: The highest acceptable value, in the unit below.

min.description: The lowest acceptable value, in the unit below.

unit.description: The unit of the bounds. It defaults to the nutrient's own; a micronutrient defaults to the published percent.

nutrients.description: Range per nutrient, e.g. {"protein":{"min":20,"unit":"g"}}. A constraint drops dishes with no value.

offset.description: Pages of the range to skip.

query.description: A case-insensitive substring of the dish name.

require_traits.description: Keeps only the dishes that carry every one of these traits.

sort_by.description: Sort field: a nutrient key, carbonFootprint, a micronutrient name, servingSize, mhealthyTier, or a ratio "numerator:denominator" (e.g. "protein:calories", "vitaminA:iron"). Legacy: proteinToCalorie, fiberToCalorie.

sort_order.description: The direction of the sort. It defaults to desc, so the biggest value comes first.

to.description: The last day of a range to filter. Defaults to the last published day.

name: filter_dishes
title: Filter dishes
